name: authz-close
decisions: M1 adminPeer fail-closed (HasCred required) + refuse handshake on cred read failure for unix conns + flip test row + non-root re-exec test; M2 endpoint-side -nfs-allow CIDR list, required when -nfs-server set (exit 78 if missing), CreateVolume nfs_export and PublishFileExport clients must be inside; drop-in placeholder; ADR 0001 consequences corrected; L1 exact health method set; L2 dev/ino check before unlink; L3 ancestor dirs not group/other-writable unless sticky; L4 deny-form CapabilityBoundingSet of clearly-unneeded caps + TestUnitLint (verify on VM unit test); refuse -socket-group gid 0

name: scan-slots
items: F1 delete listing takes a slot; F2 reserved slot for lock-holding scans (CreateSnapshot, reconcile rescan)
